about_the_game:
The SCP foundation was once a prestigious organization dedicated to maintaining order in the world and suppressing supernatural anomalies however today, the SCP facility has fallen into insanity with it's management dominated by brain rotted morons and it's power worsening day by day.... not only allowing the dangers contained within to break out but also a certain bloodthirsty intruder to infiltrate in, only a matter of time before all hell breaks loose in the fever dream chaos of the story.

The brain rotted morons that reside down in the facility each have a quirk uniquely wrong with them (from the schizophrenic addict lars, a d class inmate of the facility to our protagonist cat girl sinner, the reincarnation of the demon the scarlet king!) as they all play a role within the group dynamic whilst also having their own concealed arcs and ambitions under the surface... not all of these arcs will be completed however as no one is safe from the narratives brutality so not all will survive...

SCP: Yet Another Day's combat uses a hybrid gameplay system between a dynamic RPG and a turn based card game, blend card combinations together to create absurd decks that exploit the games mechanics and clear your enemies, culminating in deadly bosses that put your skills to the challenge and demand calculated adapting to win.

AN EXPANSIVE LORE - The history of the foundation stretches across time and beyond with several secrets behind the scenes to be put together presenting an layered mystery.

UNIQUE PLAYTHROUGHS - Depending on what traits are chosen by the player the dialogue they experience will be specialized to them allowing them to discover information others do not.

THE CHAOS INSURGENCY HAS HIJACKED THIS DESCRIPTION - Do not be fooled by the foundation, they are corrupt and not what they seem... this must be stopped, that is why we at the chaos insurgency, the greatest faction in the verse are calling YOU to join the rebellion and FIGHT BACK!

PLAY THE FIRST ACT OF THIS FEVER DREAM OF A GAME NOW !!!

short_description: SCP: Yet Another Day is an action RPG and a satirical look at the SCP foundation, When a load of morons are put in charge of a facility containing monsters deep underground- it doesn't take long before everything crumbles and a great evil is unleashed which threatens their lives.
